status: desktop account and notes sync implemented in local development build; Go and web deployed
start: automatically after login; no enable switch and no cloud/local note types

states.label: 正在同步
states.display: small progress indicator; desktop editing remains available

states.label: 离线，内容已保存在本机
states.display: last successful sync time and pending count

states.label: 同步未完成
states.display: actionable error; last successful sync time
states.action: retry with capped backoff; retain local outbox

states.label: 发现两处修改
states.action: keep both revisions, create conflict copy; allow comparison and explicit resolution

states.label: 请重新登录以继续同步
states.action: keep local saves and outbox; pause network sync until authenticated

isolation.identity: one global user account across applications
isolation.serverScope: all data access requires authenticated user_id plus app_id
isolation.localScope: separate guest and account-specific caches; never upload another account cache
isolation.logout: clear tokens; retain account-specific local files as an explicit policy, hide that cache from other accounts in the app; do not claim filesystem encryption
isolation.firstLogin: automatically enroll current guest notes after explaining the rule; stable note IDs avoid duplicates

recovery.delete: tombstone with recovery period; no immediate irreversible purge
recovery.conflict: base revision check, preserve both copies
recovery.networkFailure: never report synced before server acknowledgement

previewRule: static demo pages must not display success-like sync states or pretend to authenticate

currentDelivery.email: SMTP not configured; verification optional and currently disabled
